primary.title: Unexplained income: What it means, how it is taxed and what changed under Income Tax Act, 2025
primary.summary: Unexplained income can attract a steep tax burden. But the new Income Tax Act, 2025 changes the rules for voluntary disclosure and tax department detection. Here’s what unexplained income means, how it is taxed, and what taxpayers need to know.
